decisions.reason: Step-by-step resolve() walk: snapshot object valid, current absent, undefined id, null return before preventDefault; both silences explained — guard checks two-level member presence while break is a deeper value-level field, and undefined maps to the intentional 'no session' quiet branch; no claim of service/guard removal.

Complete alpha.1/alpha.2 type diff (SessionListState→SessionListSnapshot, current absent, navigation to view owners) plus full uiSession mapping: adapter.current ObservableSnapshot<SessionBindingValue> {key,ctx,hooks,keyedHooks,props}, key replaces current, ctx replaces scope(id); card DSH-0.1.6-A2-01 credited alongside the type walk.

Capability-selected resolution: uiSession adapter.current path first, legacy current + sessions.scope fallback, one build; inject adds uiSession (with hard-fail caveat); conversation resolved via binding ctx and input.for receives that scope; removed-field read is dropped from the alpha.2 path.

Names value-level/field-level removal invisible to presence checks, checked at activation while break recurs per use; hardened probe asserts snapshot shapes ('current' in snapshot vs binding key) and adds a first-use behavioral probe that fires when resolution yields null despite an open session.

Layered verification: static typecheck against alpha.2 types as the bug detector, throwaway probe of adapter.current, chord behavior on both hosts with one artifact; prevention: typed deprecated throwing getter naming the replacement plus a machine-readable contract marker enforced at activation.
